title: The rate of change in the direction (3, 4)
caption: At (1, 2) the gradient of f = x² + y² is (2, 4). The unit vector u = (3, 4)/5 = (0.6, 0.8) points the chosen way, and the rate of change is the dot product ∇f · u = 1.2 + 3.2 = 4.4 = 22/5, less than |∇f| = √20 ≈ 4.47.
alt: From the point (1, 2): the gradient vector (2, 4) and a shorter unit vector (0.6, 0.8) in the direction (3, 4), slightly turned from the gradient.
description: The direction (3, 4) has length 5, so the unit vector is u = (0.6, 0.8).
